parsed.why: Documented police register of LGBTIQ people, fake-meeting entrapment, extortion, raids and abuse with no anti-discrimination law, no trans care, and entirely negative official/social climate: state-tolerated targeting of the outed.

Decriminalised by 2022 court ruling, but no SOGI protections, no legal recognition, LGBTQ people avoid police; dated 2005 port exclusion and thin enforcement record leave outed traveller with no recourse.

Gender identity protected since 2013 with damages awarded in court, national hate-crime law covering gender identity (2025), lived-gender prison standards; friction over facilities and one state's youth-care restrictions, but working remedies.

Strong constitutional protection, self-ID, marriage and conversion-therapy ban, but persistent documented male-prison placement of trans women including a foreign detainee, violence in custody, and rising anti-LGBT violence amid armed conflict.

No criminalisation and fragmented protections plus gender-identity hate-crime law and police address guidelines, but enforcement weak, complaints disregarded, heteronormative hostility, surgery-gated recognition; violence record dated to 2014.
